contexts.text: God remembered () = ... in special, that He had mercy: His remembrance is mercy, which is especially predicated after temptation... As this appears so, God remembers = the end of the temptation, and the beginning of renovation.
I will remember My covenant () = the Lord's mercy towards the regenerate... for to remember cannot be predicated of the Lord ... See AC 1055.
That the Lord remembered. Signified, Explained.
It was recalled to my remembrance that...
When a man remembers another... there is presented one obscure [idea]... But when, as a Spirit, he remembers him... there are presented all the ideas he ever had about him. Explained.
Man is then led successively into full remembrance...
God remembered Rachel () = foresight. Explained.
By baptism they might remember regeneration; by the Holy Supper they might remember the Lord and His love...
He is continually in remembrance of the Lord... although he does not know that he then remembers Him; for the remembrance of the Lord by those in faith is a thing which reigns universally...
He did not remember Joseph () = not as yet conjunction in every way.

I remember my sins this day () = concerning the state of disjunction... (for) to remember = conjunction... because in the other life the remembrance of anyone conjoins; for, as soon as any Spirit remembers another, he is presented... (This is) when the Lord grants that they should remember them.
Joseph remembered the dreams... () = that (it) foresaw what world happen... (for) to remember = presence; because a Thing of which remembrance takes place, is presented...
When a scientific comes into the thought, the truths collated into it come into remembrance...
I have remembered My covenant () = exemption from infestations. Explained.
It treats in () of perpetual remembrance of deliverance by the Lord.
A sign = perpetual remembrance (in relation to the Voluntary).
A memorial = perpetual remembrance (in relation to the Intellectual).
Remembrance of the state of temptation in which they had been. Signified, Explained.
The remembrance of all that befell the evil... Signified.
Ye have seen = remembrance.
Remember () = what is perpetual in the thought. Explained.
The delight of the remembrance of spiritual good. Signified, Explained.
(Such) do what is good as often as they remember it.
Remembrance. Signified, Explained.
If there is no remembrance. Signified, Explained.

When man is in good... he comes into the remembrance of all the truths which have entered the good... (and) truths which have disappeared come again into remembrance when the man returns into the affection of good or of truth, through life.
To tie a scarlet thread = for the sake of the memory or remembrance of the Thing.
Stones of remembrance for the sons of Israel () = from mercy in perpetuity...
It is said of the Lord that He remembers, and that He does not remember, by which is signified that it is done from mercy, whether it is preservation, or deliverance...
Everyone may know that to remember cannot be predicated of the Lord...
That to remember, when said of the Lord, = to have mercy, and thus to preserve, or deliver, from mercy. Illustrated. AC 9850. AC 9904.
It shall be... for remembrance before Jehovah () = thus the preservation of the Church... by the Lord.
The feast of the Passover... was instituted in remembrance of the deliverance of man from Hell.
a. [3]. All the particulars... were brought to their remembrance...
There are many [departments] of wisdom; as recollection, etc.
Presence (there) is from the remembrance of another...
Remembrance of their error. Signified.
This do in remembrance of Me (). Explained. TCR 709:end. TCR 710.
(Seeming recollections of things which have never happened.) SE 3917.
They snatched it away, so that I could not remember it. SE 5904.
How spirits remember others. Explained.
Write = for remembrance. AE 112.
Remember Egypt no more () = no longer any knowledge of truth.
To remember, when said of God, = to separate Himself from them. Explained.
